description.value: Hope Key is a family-owned Chinese restaurant on Douglas Street in the heart of Victoria, serving fresh Chinese food, daily specials, and an extensive real-fruit bubble tea menu with over a dozen flavour options. The restaurant is fully licensed for dine-in and accepts takeout orders directly or through UberEats, DoorDash, Fantuan, and SkipTheDishes. Combination meals sized for one to six or more diners, plus catering and gift certificates, make it a flexible resupply stop for groups of touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at hopekey.ca is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM record: the contact page confirms address as 1313 Douglas St, Victoria, BC V8W 2E9 and provides phone 250-382-6048, which is absent from OSM tags. The homepage explicitly advertises takeout and the menu page includes a dedicated Vegetarian Dishes section with multiple meatless entries. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill appears in either the website or OSM tags.
concerns: Phone 250-382-6048 sourced from website only; OSM record has no phone field to cross-check.
Address expanded to full civic address (city, province, postal code) using website contact page; OSM had only street number and name.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, family-owned restaurant in central Victoria with confirmed takeout options and a vegetarian menu section — a practical food stop for touring cyclists. Bike parking status unknown but does not preclude listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated 'Vegetarian Dishes' section on menu includes vegetarian spring rolls, vegetarian samosa, tempura vegetables and yam, tofu with seasonal vegetables, and Szechwan spicy tofu. No explicit vegan or gluten-free claims made
